WITH requirement_history AS ( SELECT ms.account_id,r.ingredient_id, AVG(r.quantity) average_required_qty, COUNT(*) menu_usage_count, MAX(ms.meal_date) last_used_at FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.status='COMPLETED' AND r.reversed_at IS NULL AND ms.meal_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE,INTERVAL COALESCE(#{average_days},30) DAY) AND ms.meal_date<=CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY ms.account_id,r.ingredient_id ) SELECT b.inventory_balance_id,ai.account_id,ai.ingredient_id, COALESCE(b.current_base_qty,0) current_base_qty,COALESCE(b.current_qty,0) current_qty, COALESCE(b.base_unit,ai.base_unit) base_unit,COALESCE(b.current_unit,b.base_unit,ai.base_unit) current_unit, COALESCE(b.average_unit_cost,0) average_unit_cost,COALESCE(b.inventory_amount,0) inventory_amount, b.last_movement_at,b.note, COALESCE(b.location_id,ai.default_location_id,'L999') location_id, ai.safe_stock_base_qty configured_safe_stock_qty,ai.max_stock_base_qty,ai.lead_time_days, COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw,im.ingredient_name_std,im.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ai.category_name,''),im.category_name) category_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ai.storage_type,''),im.storage_type) storage_type, lot.product_name_snapshot recent_product_name,lot.received_date recent_received_date, p.image_url,p.thumbnail_url,s.supplier_name recent_supplier_name,
CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_movement mv WHERE mv.account_id=ai.account_id AND mv.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id AND mv.movement_type='OPENING' AND mv.reference_type='OPENING_ESTIMATED') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END opening_cost_estimated,
CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_movement mv WHERE mv.account_id=ai.account_id AND mv.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id AND mv.movement_type<>'ADJUST') THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END opening_available, COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0) average_usage_qty,rh.last_used_at, COALESCE(rh.menu_usage_count,0) menu_usage_count, ai.max_stock_base_qty total_capacity_qty,ROUND(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0),3) required_qty, ROUND(GREATEST(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)*1.10,COALESCE(ai.safe_stock_base_qty,0)),3) safe_stock_base_qty, ROUND(GREATEST(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)-COALESCE(b.current_base_qty,0),0),3) shortage_qty, ROUND(GREATEST(GREATEST(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)*1.10,COALESCE(ai.safe_stock_base_qty,0))-COALESCE(b.current_base_qty,0),0),3) order_needed_qty, (SELECT rd.menu_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd WHERE rd.account_id=ai.account_id AND rd.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id ORDER BY rd.menu_id LIMIT 1) menu_id, (SELECT am.menu_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master am ON am.account_id=rd.account_id AND am.menu_id=rd.menu_id WHERE rd.account_id=ai.account_id AND rd.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id AND am.del_yn='N' ORDER BY rd.menu_id LIMIT 1) menu_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(b.current_base_qty,0)<=0 AND COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)>0 THEN 'RED' WHEN COALESCE(b.current_base_qty,0)<=0 THEN 'EMPTY' WHEN b.current_base_qty<COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0) THEN 'ORANGE' WHEN rh.last_used_at IS NULL AND ai.max_stock_base_qty>0 AND b.current_base_qty/ai.max_stock_base_qty<=0.30 THEN 'YELLOW' WHEN COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)<=0 THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'GREEN' END stock_status FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b ON b.account_id=ai.account_id AND b.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master im ON im.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot lot ON lot.inventory_lot_id=( SELECT l.inventory_lot_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_id=ai.account_id AND l.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id ORDER BY l.received_date DESC,l.inventory_lot_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=lot.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id LEFT JOIN requirement_history rh ON rh.account_id=ai.account_id AND rh.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id WHERE ai.account_id=#{account_id} AND ai.active_yn='Y'
AND (b.inventory_balance_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd WHERE rd.account_id=ai.account_id AND rd.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id)) AND b.inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id} AND ai.ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} ORDER BY FIELD(stock_status,'RED','EMPTY','ORANGE','YELLOW','UNKNOWN','GREEN'),ingredient_name

SELECT i.ingredient_id,COALESCE(i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, i.ingredient_name_raw,i.ingredient_name_std,i.category_name,i.base_unit,i.storage_type, i.menu_usage_count,i.needs_review,i.note,i.standard_unit_cost,i.standard_cost_mod_at FROM the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i WHERE 1=1 AND i.ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} ORDER BY i.category_name,ingredient_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master (ingredient_id,ingredient_name_raw,ingredient_name_std,category_name,base_unit,order_unit,convert_value, standard_unit_cost,standard_cost_mod_at,storage_type,menu_usage_count,needs_review,note,created_at,safe_stock_qty) VALUES (#{ingredient_id},#{ingredient_name},#{ingredient_name},#{category_name},#{base_unit},#{order_unit},#{convert_value}, #{standard_unit_cost},CASE WHEN #{standard_unit_cost} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE NOW() END, NULLIF(#{storage_type},''),COALESCE(#{menu_usage_count},0),COALESCE(#{needs_review},0),#{note},NOW(),COALESCE(#{safe_stock_qty},0))
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master SET ingredient_name_raw=#{ingredient_name},ingredient_name_std=#{ingredient_name},category_name=#{category_name}, base_unit=#{base_unit},storage_type=NULLIF(#{storage_type},''),note=#{note}, standard_cost_mod_at=CASE WHEN NOT (standard_unit_cost <=> #{standard_unit_cost}) THEN NOW() ELSE standard_cost_mod_at END, standard_unit_cost=#{standard_unit_cost},mod_at=NOW() WHERE ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance(account_id,ingredient_id,location_id,current_base_qty,base_unit,current_unit,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{ingredient_id},COALESCE(NULLIF(#{location_id},''),'L999'),0,#{base_unit},#{base_unit},#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE inventory_balance_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(inventory_balance_id)
mapper.select: SELECT inventory_balance_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} AND location_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(#{location_id},''),'L999')

SELECT b.inventory_balance_id,pp.ingredient_id,pp.base_unit price_unit, CASE WHEN pp.manual_cost>0 THEN pp.manual_cost WHEN lot.receipt_unit_cost>0 THEN lot.receipt_unit_cost ELSE pp.standard_cost END unit_cost, CASE WHEN pp.manual_cost>0 THEN 'MANUAL' WHEN lot.receipt_unit_cost>0 THEN 'RECENT_RECEIPT' WHEN pp.standard_cost>0 THEN 'STANDARD' END cost_source, CASE WHEN pp.manual_cost>0 THEN pp.manual_date WHEN lot.receipt_unit_cost>0 THEN lot.received_date ELSE pp.standard_date END cost_date FROM () pp
LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b ON b.account_id=pp.account_id AND b.ingredient_id=pp.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot lot ON lot.inventory_lot_id=( SELECT l.inventory_lot_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_id=pp.account_id AND l.ingredient_id=pp.ingredient_id AND l.receipt_unit_cost>0 ORDER BY l.received_date DESC,l.inventory_lot_id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE pp.account_id=#{account_id} AND b.inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id} AND pp.ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_movement WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} AND movement_type<>'ADJUST'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance WHERE inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id} AND current_base_qty=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT inventory_balance_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage) u WHERE u.inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id})

SELECT pg.*, ms.meal_date,COALESCE(sm.meal_slot_name,ms.meal_slot) meal_slot_name,mm.menu_name, gr.receipt_date,po.client_ord,po.purchase_order_id,po.requested_delivery_date FROM ( SELECT m.*,COALESCE(m.product_name_snapshot,p.product_name) product_name,p.supplier_item_code,s.supplier_name, COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw,im.ingredient_name_std,im.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name
ORDER BY m.movement_at DESC,m.movement_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) pg LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage u ON pg.reference_type='MEAL_SERVICE' AND u.usage_id=pg.reference_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=u.meal_service_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_meal_slot_master sm ON sm.meal_slot_code=COALESCE(ms.meal_slot_code,CAST(ms.meal_slot AS UNSIGNED)) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master mm ON mm.account_id=u.account_id AND mm.menu_id=u.menu_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt_item gri ON pg.reference_type='GOODS_RECEIPT' AND gri.inventory_movement_id=pg.movement_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt gr ON gr.goods_receipt_id=gri.goods_receipt_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order po ON po.purchase_order_id=gr.purchase_order_id ORDER BY pg.movement_at DESC,pg.movement_id DESC

SELECT m.movement_type,COUNT(*) movement_count,SUM(m.quantity_delta) quantity_sum, SUM(COALESCE(m.amount_delta,0)) amount_sum,COUNT(DISTINCT m.base_unit) unit_count,MIN(m.base_unit) base_unit
GROUP BY m.movement_type
